tagline: Ten days of chamber music in kitchens, chapels and concert halls.
intro: Placeholder. In its first season the festival brought a small company of musicians to Yarmouth for ten days of concerts in intimate spaces, from a farmhouse kitchen in Hebron to a candlelit cemetery chapel.
scheduleNote: Seating is limited at every event. Doors open thirty minutes before each concert.

events.title: Classical Kitchen Party
description: An intimate house concert that brings artists and listeners together over music, stories and Maritime hospitality. Refreshments included.

events.title: Night Music in the Dark
description: A candlelit evening of luminous, unhurried music in the historic chapel. Dress warmly.

events.title: Finale
description: A celebratory program pairing beloved repertoire with a world premiere inspired by Yarmouth's coastal landscape. A reception with the artists follows.
